title: "GIS Graph"
author: "Ria Rhodes"
output: html_document

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Loading in libraries
library(sf)
library(USAboundaries)
library(leaflet)
library(scales)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
# Loading in data
clean <- read.csv("clean.csv")
head(clean)
```

```{r}
# Defining states
states_sf <- USAboundaries::us_states() %>%
  dplyr::filter(!name %in% c(
    "Puerto Rico", "Guam", "American Samoa",
    "U.S. Virgin Islands", "Northern Mariana Islands"
  ))
```

```{r}
# Defining states I am using
states_to_map <- c(
  "Tennessee",
  "California",
  "Maine",
  "New Jersey",
  "Arkansas",
  "Arizona"
)
```

```{r}
# Getting the average percent change in states
state_avg <- clean %>%
  group_by(state) %>%
  summarize(avg_pct_change = mean(`x1_month_percent_change`, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
# Joining state names to state
map_data <- states_sf %>%
  left_join(state_avg, by = c("state_name" = "state"))
```

```{r}
# Finding the center
centroids <- st_centroid(map_data)
```

```{r}
# Keeping only data from my chosen states
map_data_sub <- map_data %>%
  filter(state_name %in% states_to_map)

centroids_sub <- centroids %>%
  filter(state_name %in% states_to_map)
```

```{r}
# Interactive leaflet GIS map of average percent change in unemployment
pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = c("#FF9ACD", "#FF4F8B", "#B3003C", "#4A001F"),
  domain = map_data_sub$avg_pct_change
)

usmap <- leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles("OpenStreetMap.HOT") %>%
  addPolygons(
    data = map_data_sub,
    fillColor = "white",
    fillOpacity = 0.2,
    color = "gray40",
    weight = 4
  ) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = centroids_sub,
    lng = ~st_coordinates(geometry)[,1],
    lat = ~st_coordinates(geometry)[,2],
    radius = ~scales::rescale(avg_pct_change, to = c(8, 20)),
    color = ~pal(avg_pct_change),
    fillOpacity = 0.9,
    stroke = FALSE,
    label = ~paste0(
      "<b>", state_name, "</b><br>",
      "Avg % Change: ", round(avg_pct_change, 2)
    ) %>% lapply(htmltools::HTML)
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = pal,
    values = map_data_sub$avg_pct_change,
    title = "Avg Monthly % Change",
    opacity = 1,
    na.label = ""   # ensures no N/A box
  )

print(usmap)
```
